title: Police Blotter: 14 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 12, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — assault, theft, DWI and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday, November 12, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Oscar Fabian Valdez

Oscar Fabian Valdez was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, on alleged charges of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor, and reckless driving, a misdemeanor. The time of arrest was not shown in the booking record. Bond was set at $500 on the marijuana charge and $2,500 on the reckless driving charge. He was arrested by the Department of Public Safety.

Alan Arron Martinez

Alan Arron Martinez was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 2:44 a.m. on alleged charges of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor, and possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000 on the marijuana charge and $2,000 on the controlled substance charge. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Francisco Javier Cortez-Rojas

Francisco Javier Cortez-Rojas was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 3:17 a.m. on an alleged charge of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. The booking record also shows an immigration hold with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. He was arrested by the Department of Public Safety.

James Haynes

James Haynes was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:36 a.m. on an alleged charge of criminal trespass, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $500. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Destiny Faith Mariscal

Destiny Faith Mariscal was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 7:14 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,000. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Ilse Llaneth Garcia

Ilse Llaneth Garcia was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 9:32 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury — family violence, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Andrew Garcia

Andrew Garcia was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 9:51 a.m. on alleged charges of accident involving damage to a vehicle of $200 or more, a Class B misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Luis A. Cisneros-Aguilar

Luis A. Cisneros-Aguilar was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 11:08 a.m. on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor, and interference with an emergency request for assistance, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The booking record also shows an immigration hold with U.S. Customs and Border Protection. He was arrested by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

Jose Ernesto Aranda

Jose Ernesto Aranda was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 1:08 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,000. He was arrested by the United ISD Police Department.

Daniela Jazmin Hernandez

Daniela Jazmin Hernandez was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 1:41 p.m. on alleged charges of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor; resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor; and theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on any of the charges at the time of booking. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Carlos Daniel Banda

Carlos Daniel Banda was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:10 p.m. on an alleged charge of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 3, less than 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,000 (personal recognizance). He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department. He was released later the same day, according to court records.

Bulmaro Gaspar-Gaspar

Bulmaro Gaspar-Gaspar was booked on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 6:56 p.m. on a federal violation hold with the United States Marshals. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He was arrested by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

Simon Palacios

Simon Palacios was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 7:38 p.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury to a family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Rafael Ramirez

Rafael Ramirez was arrested on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 10:20 p.m. on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, less than 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He was arrested by the Department of Public Safety.
